title: World League Soccer '98
overview: Sega are on the ball again to bring you World League Soccer '98. The beautiful game is recreated perfectly to give up to four players hectic arcade action. With over two-hundred teams, fourteen stadiums and expert commentary from Peter Brackley and Ray Wilkins, you'll be as sick as a parrot if you don't pick up on this stunning new game. World League Soccer '98... You know the score.
